rationale: The -1.52% gap-down was absorbed rather than extended — price has ground back above session VWAP ($51.86) and the 9-EMA on 5.45x relative volume, and the last 1m candles are closing at their highs with rising volume while coiling just under the session high, indicating buyers are in control of the tape. The trade joins that reclaim-and-continue move toward the unfilled gap, with the prior-day low at $52.42 as the first overhead target, and invalidates below VWAP where the recovery structure would fail. Confidence is only modest because the entry is near range highs (94% of daily range) and the broad tape is risk-off (VIXY +1.24%), so the position is kept small with risk (~$0.19/share) well inside the remaining loss budget.
